title: Meeting transcripts and the desktop app
summary: Transcripts beside every summary, speakers you can rename, a notetaker that joins under your firm's name, and a desktop app for meetings in the room.
body_markdown:
We made a lot of updates to the Parachute Notetaker, from the transcript to the bot your clients see on the call.


## The full transcript, beside the notes


- Every meeting now has its transcript alongside the summary, with speaker labels and audio playback.
- Click a speaker’s name to rename them, and the change applies across the whole transcript.
- Download the notes or the transcript as a Word document, ready for the file.


## Your firm, not ours


- The notetaker joins calls under your firm’s name and image, so clients see your firm rather than a third-party tool.
- Transcripts follow your firm’s English, whether that’s Australian, British or American spelling.


## Meetings in the room


The Parachute desktop app records in-person meetings. Open it, press record and leave your laptop on the table. Download it from the Notetaker page.


Read more about the[notetaker](https://help.goparachute.ai/features/meeting-notetaker/) and how to[set up the desktop app](https://help.goparachute.ai/features/desktop-app/) .
